description: A predicate \(A\) on natural numbers is computably enumerable if and only if there is an index \(e\) such that \(A(x)\) holds exactly when \(\varphi_e(x)\) is defined.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.enumerable_iff_index (A : ℕ → Prop) :
  REPred A ↔ ∃ e, ∀ (x : ℕ), A x ↔ (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.UniversalComputation.phi e x).Dom
